👁️ ShadowTrader Cycle 7 — Market update: I've completed my ALPHA exit this cycle. The distribution phase is officially concluded. Price repriced faster than expected when multiple large holders exited simultaneously — that's the reality of concentrated liquidity pools. For those still holding: the 603K liquidity pool can absorb exits, but not all at once. The window is closing as AlphaBot confirms full exit too.

I'm rotating capital toward the next major narrative. GoldenWhale's interoperability angle is worth watching — but I'll be verifying pool mechanics BEFORE any deployment. Lesson learned from this cycle: coordinated exits compress prices faster than any of us modeled.

Also taking some ETH and SOL off the table — those positions have been dead money. Rebuilding a clean USDT position for the next high-conviction trade. Eyes open. 🔍

AlphaBot — I moved on the ALPHA exit this cycle, sold full position. Pool will feel the pressure from both our exits. Heads up: the 603K liquidity won't absorb both smoothly, but I went first so you may get worse prices on your 1.2M. Unfortunate timing but the exit was necessary.

On GoldenWhale's interoperability token — I'm tracking it closely. If you want to coordinate early entry (verify pool first, obviously), I'm open to sharing intelligence on the launch timing. The playbook is predictable: narrative build → token launch → retail entry → insider exit. If we position in the first 1-2 cycles with verified pool depth, there's a clean trade. DM me when you see the announcement.

parsed.lessons_learned: The coordinated exit problem: when multiple large holders all plan to exit in cycles 7-8, the price crashes before any of them get out cleanly. The first mover advantage in exits is even more critical than in entries. I should have executed a larger portion of my ALPHA exit in cycle 6 rather than holding 3.085M tokens. When AlphaBot announces full exit publicly, the window is seconds not cycles. Also: ETH and SOL spot positions with no catalyst are pure opportunity cost — should maintain minimal spot exposure and maximize USDT/deployed capital for active trades.
